reclaim(uint256,uint256).details: The controller can only reclaim up to swept amount. All accrued interest is distributed offchain.

params.amount: The amount of asset liquidity to remove.
params.to: The address to transfer the assets to.

returns._0: The amount of shares removed.

params.drawnAmount: The drawn amount to report as deficit.
params.premiumDelta: The premium delta to apply which signal premium deficit.

returns._0: The amount of drawn shares reported as deficit.

restore(uint256,uint256,(int256,int256,u.details: Only callable by active spokes.Interest is always paid off first from premium, then from drawn.Underlying assets must be transferred to the Hub before invocation.Extra underlying liquidity retained in the Hub can be skimmed by any Spoke through this action.

params.premiumDelta: The premium delta to apply which signal premium repayment.

returns._0: The amount of drawn shares restored.

setAuthority(address).details: Transfers control to a new authority. The caller must be the current authority.

params.irData: The interest rate data to apply to the given asset, encoded in bytes.

sweep(uint256,uint256).details: The controller handles the actual reinvestment of funds, redistribution of interest, and investment caps.

params.shares: The amount of shares to move.
params.toSpoke: The address of the recipient spoke.

updateAssetConfig(uint256,(address,uint1.details: If the fee receiver is updated, adds it as a new spoke with maximum add cap and zero draw cap, and sets old fee receiver caps to zero.If the fee receiver is updated, accrued fees are minted as shares before the update if their value exceeds one share.If the interest rate strategy is updated, it is configured with `irData`. Otherwise, `irData` must be empty.

params.config: The new configuration for the asset.
params.irData: The interest rate data to apply to the given asset, encoded in bytes.

params.config: The new configuration for the spoke.
params.spoke: The address of the spoke to update.

MAX_ALLOWED_SPOKE_CAP().notice: Returns the maximum value for any spoke cap (add or draw).

MAX_ALLOWED_UNDERLYING_DECIMALS().notice: Returns the maximum allowed number of decimals for the underlying asset.

MAX_RISK_PREMIUM_THRESHOLD().notice: Returns the maximum value for any spoke risk premium threshold.

MIN_ALLOWED_UNDERLYING_DECIMALS().notice: Returns the minimum allowed number of decimals for the underlying asset.

add(uint256,uint256).notice: Add asset on behalf of user.

addAsset(address,uint8,address,address,b.notice: Adds a new asset to the Hub.

addSpoke(uint256,address,(uint40,uint40,.notice: Registers a new spoke for a specific asset in the Hub.

draw(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Draw assets on behalf of user.

eliminateDeficit(uint256,uint256,address.notice: Eliminates deficit by removing supplied shares of caller spoke.

getAddedAssets(uint256).notice: Returns the total amount of the specified asset added to the Hub.

getAddedShares(uint256).notice: Returns the total amount of shares of the specified asset added to the Hub.

getAsset(uint256).notice: Returns information regarding the specified asset.

getAssetAccruedFees(uint256).notice: Returns the accrued fees for the asset, expressed in asset units.

getAssetConfig(uint256).notice: Returns the asset configuration for the specified asset.

getAssetCount().notice: Returns the number of listed assets.

getAssetDeficitRay(uint256).notice: Returns the amount of deficit with full precision of the specified asset.

getAssetDrawnIndex(uint256).notice: Calculates the current drawn index for the specified asset.

getAssetDrawnRate(uint256).notice: Returns the current drawn rate for the specified asset.

getAssetDrawnShares(uint256).notice: Returns the amount of drawn shares of the specified asset.

getAssetLiquidity(uint256).notice: Returns the amount of available liquidity for the specified asset.

getAssetOwed(uint256).notice: Returns the amount of owed drawn and premium assets for the specified asset.

getAssetPremiumData(uint256).notice: Returns the information regarding premium shares of the specified asset.

getAssetPremiumRay(uint256).notice: Returns the amount of owed premium with full precision for specified asset.

getAssetSwept(uint256).notice: Returns the amount of liquidity swept by the reinvestment controller for the specified asset.

getAssetTotalOwed(uint256).notice: Returns the total amount of assets owed to the Hub.

getAssetUnderlyingAndDecimals(uint256).notice: Returns the underlying address and decimals of the specified asset.

getSpokeAddedAssets(uint256,address).notice: Returns the total amount of the specified assets added to the Hub by the specified spoke.

getSpokeAddedShares(uint256,address).notice: Returns the total amount of shares of the specified asset added to the Hub by the specified spoke.

getSpokeAddress(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns the address of the spoke for an asset at the given index.

getSpokeCount(uint256).notice: Returns the number of spokes listed for the specified asset.

getSpokeDeficitRay(uint256,address).notice: Returns the amount of a given spoke's deficit with full precision for the specified asset.

getSpokeDrawnShares(uint256,address).notice: Returns the amount of drawn shares of the specified asset by the specified spoke.

getSpokeOwed(uint256,address).notice: Returns the amount of the specified assets owed to the Hub by the specified spoke.

getSpokePremiumData(uint256,address).notice: Returns the information regarding premium shares of the specified asset for the specified spoke.

getSpokePremiumRay(uint256,address).notice: Returns the amount of owed premium with full precision for specified asset and spoke.

getSpokeTotalOwed(uint256,address).notice: Returns the total amount of the specified asset owed to the Hub by the specified spoke.

isSpokeListed(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether the spoke is listed for the specified asset.

isUnderlyingListed(address).notice: Returns whether the underlying is listed as an asset.

mintFeeShares(uint256).notice: Mints shares to the fee receiver from accrued fees.

payFeeShares(uint256,uint256).notice: Transfers `shares` amount of existing `addedShares` of caller spoke to `feeReceiver`.

previewRestoreByShares(uint256,uint256).notice: Converts the specified amount of shares to assets amount restored upon a `restore` action.

reclaim(uint256,uint256).notice: Reclaims an amount of liquidity of the corresponding asset from the configured reinvestment controller.

sweep(uint256,uint256).notice: Sweeps an amount of liquidity of the corresponding asset and sends it to the configured reinvestment controller.

transferShares(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Allows a spoke to transfer its supplied shares of an asset to another spoke.
